test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Personal disposable income (PDI) can be defined as ______.

options.text: PI + Personal tax payments + Non-tax payments
PI + Personal tax payments - Non-tax payments
PI - Personal tax payments - Non-tax payments
PI - Personal tax payments + Non-tax payments

solution:
The correct answer is __**PI - Personal tax payments - Non-tax payments**__.

• The part of National Income (NI) that is received by households is referred to as Personal Income (PI).
